description: This file defines the LocalizedDateFormatter class, which handles date formatting with localization support, including translating day and month names based on locale. It uses traits for text helpers and internationalization helpers, and provides methods for formatting dates and replacing English day/month names with localized versions.

classes.name: LocalizedDateFormatter
classes.description: A helper class for formatting dates with localization support, translating day and month names based on locale.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object according to a specified format, replacing day and month names with localized versions if applicable.

methods.name: getSearchAndReplaceParams
methods.description: Determines the search and replace parameters for localizing day and month names based on the date format.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForShortDays
methods.description: Prepares search and replace arrays for short day names in the given date format.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForLongDays
methods.description: Prepares search and replace arrays for long day names in the given date format.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForShortMonth
methods.description: Prepares search and replace arrays for short month names in the given date format.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForLongMonth
methods.description: Prepares search and replace arrays for long month names in the given date format.
